build_furthest_point_sample: build a python module to run furthest_point_sample on a batch of 3D point cloud coordinates
build_furthest_point_sample_with_dist: build a python module to run furthest_point_sample_with_dist on a precomputed pairwise distance matrix
test_FurthestPointSampling: test the FurthestPointSampling class by sampling N points from a (B, N, 3) point cloud tensor
test_FurthestPointSamplingWithDist: test the FurthestPointSamplingWithDist class by sampling N points from a (B, N, N) distance tensor
review_furthest_point_sample_ext: review the furthest_point_sample_ext CUDA extension wrapper calls used by both sampling functions
